theorem Rudin_exercise_5_5
  {f : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioi 0))
  (hf : Tendsto (deriv f) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
  Tendsto (λ x => f (x + 1) - f x) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop] at hf ⊢
  intro ε hε
  rcases hf ε hε with ⟨N, hN⟩
  refine ⟨max N 1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ x := le_of_max_le_right hx
  have hxN : N ≤ x := le_of_max_le_left hx
  have hx_lt : x < x + 1 := lt_add_one x
  have h_sub : Set.Icc x (x + 1) ⊆ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Set.mem_Ioi]
    have : (0 : ℝ) < 1 := by norm_num
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le this (le_trans hx1 hy.1)
  have h_sub' : Set.Ioo x (x + 1) ⊆ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro y hy
    exact h_sub (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hy)
  have hfc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc x (x + 1)) := hfd.continuousOn.mono h_sub
  have hfd' : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Set.Ioo x (x + 1)) := hfd.mono h_sub'
  rcases exists_deriv_eq_slope f hx_lt hfc hfd' with ⟨c, hc, hc_eq⟩
  have hc_diff : x + 1 - x = 1 := by ring
  rw [hc_diff, div_one] at hc_eq
  have hdist : dist (f (x + 1) - f x) 0 = dist (deriv f c) 0 := by
    rw [← hc_eq]
  rw [hdist]
  exact hN c (le_trans hxN (le_of_lt hc.1))

import Mathlib
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset Set
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Rudin_exercise_5_5
  {f : ℝ → ℝ}
  (hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioi 0))
  (hf : Tendsto (deriv f) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
  Tendsto (λ x => f (x + 1) - f x) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  have hε' := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hf ε hε
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hε'
  refine ⟨max N 1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hxN : N ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_left N (1 : ℝ)) hx
  have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ x := le_trans (le_max_right N (1 : ℝ)) hx
  have hx_pos : (0 : ℝ) < x := by linarith
  have hx_lt : x < x + 1 := by linarith
  have hIcc_sub : Icc x (x + 1) ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Set.mem_Ioi]
    linarith [hy.1]
  have hIoo_sub : Ioo x (x + 1) ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Set.mem_Ioi]
    linarith [hy.1]
  have hcont : ContinuousOn f (Icc x (x + 1)) :=
    hfd.continuousOn.mono hIcc_sub
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (Ioo x (x + 1)) :=
    hfd.mono hIoo_sub
  obtain ⟨c, hc_mem, hc_eq⟩ := exists_deriv_eq_slope f hx_lt hcont hdiff
  have hc_ge_N : N ≤ c := by
    have hxc : x < c := hc_mem.1
    linarith
  have hN_c : dist (deriv f c) 0 < ε := hN c hc_ge_N
  have h_sub : x + 1 - x = (1 : ℝ) := by ring
  have hc_eq' : deriv f c = f (x + 1) - f x := by
    have h1 : deriv f c = (f (x + 1) - f x) / (x + 1 - x) := hc_eq
    rw [h_sub, div_one] at h1
    exact h1
  have h_eq : f (x + 1) - f x = deriv f c := hc_eq'.symm
  calc dist (f (x + 1) - f x) 0 = dist (deriv f c) 0 := by rw [h_eq]
    _ < ε := hN_c
